title: Authenticated bounded RTO2 small-job contract
summary: For each of 20 distinct MIs, execute sum(1..1000)=500500 inside the guest and return a committed RTO2 capture through authenticated Queue Fabric/XTP to its owning MU.
invariants: The MU is controller of its local MI job; the central runner only orchestrates via sshnode.sh to owning MUs.
An MI executes real RTO2CountJob and AlchemyRTO.capture with role ACTIVE and explicit epoch; do not invent Job-to-Node lease evidence.
Returned QFXTP envelope must authenticate and bind source, destination, channel, correlation, MI, epoch and work identity.
MU must durably publish one receipt per MI; central sorter requires 20 unique commissioned routes/identities and correct result.
RTO2 local committed state does not prove remote replay, mirrored failover or distributed placement.
